title: A wavefunction and its probability
caption: For the second level of a particle in a box, ψ is positive in one half and negative in the other, with a node in the middle. The probability density ψ² is never negative and its total area is 1: the particle is certainly somewhere in the box, but never at the node.
alt: ψ for n = 2 (one full sine wave, positive then negative) and ψ² (two humps), with a node at the centre.
description: ψ: rises, falls through zero at the centre, and returns to zero at the wall.
ψ²: two equal humps, zero at the walls and at the centre.

checks.name: ψ² integrates to 1 over the box: normalised
a node at the centre for n = 2
